title: Bulk Upload Workflow
purpose: Reusable bulk upload flow from DropZone file selection through per-file DraftCards with optional AI captioning to sequential publish-all execution
description: Creator opens BulkUploadPage with empty DropZone. Files are dropped or selected (image/* + video/*). Each file gets a local UUID and object URL preview via URL.createObjectURL. Per-file DraftCards are rendered with thumbnail preview, caption textarea, and AI Caption button. Each AI caption call triggers POST /api/v1/ai/caption with 5s delay between requests and 30s delay on 429 rate limit. When creator clicks Publish All, drafts iterate sequentially: each calls POST /api/v1/content with multipart FormData (see upload pipeline D-03). Final status per draft shown. No background queue — all processing is browser-side sequential. Single failure stops Publish All unless error-handled.

validationRules.rule: Only image/* and video/* MIME types accepted
Each draft generates local UUID (not server ID)
5-second minimum delay between AI caption requests

businessRules.rule: Publish All executes sequentially per-draft, not in parallel
No background queue — all processing is browser-side sequential
No retry on individual draft failure — Publish All fails at first error

securityConsiderations: File type validation is client-side only (react-dropzone accept prop) — server must re-validate via Multer MIME filter
Blob URLs via URL.createObjectURL are not revoked — memory leak for large bulk upload sessions
No file size limit shown in client — server-side 1GB Multer limit could surprise creators
performanceConsiderations: Sequential per-draft upload is slow for many files — no parallel upload or background queue
Each file loaded into browser memory as blob URL — OOM risk with 50+ high-res files
AI caption requests sequential with 5s delay — 10 files = 50s+ for captions alone
No progress indicator per individual upload — only final success/failure per draft

annotations.text: Sequential per-draft upload — no parallel upload, no background queue, no chunking. 20 files = 20 sequential round trips.
Publish All fails at first error unless error-handled — no retry logic for individual failures
Blob URLs never revoked via URL.revokeObjectURL — memory leak in long sessions
5s delay between AI caption requests; 30s delay on 429 rate limit
